summary.oneLiner: The deck positions Uttam Sugar Mills as a 28-year-old integrated sugar company operating four units across Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh with combined 27,000 TCD cane crushing, distillery and cogeneration power capacity, and a diversified B2B/B2C sugar portfolio spanning pharma, invert and branded specialty sugars.

scorecard.wc_basis: neutral (needs 2 FYs of BS_Working capital; real from FY27)
scorecard.piotroski_basis: needs 2 FYs of BS_* -> 0 (real from FY27)
scorecard.pe_basis: TTM trailing (spec band written for forward P/E)

themes.title: Bioenergy / Ethanol / SAF transition
themes.need: Higher ethanol-blending mandates (E20->E25/E27/E30), CBG, SAF and bio-IBA underpin a multi-year bioenergy capex cycle. PRAJIND's near-term earnings are depressed by a 1G slowdown + GenX gestation but the optionality (SAF, CBG, DC-cooling) is large; TRUALT/BALRAMCHIN/EIDPARRY/TRIVENI/GODAVARIB add ethanol/sugar; BCLIND/GULPOLY/GLOBUSSPR on grain-based distillation.
themes.driver: Higher blending-mandate notifications; SAF/CBG order conversion; sugar-cycle realisations.
